name: HAVS with Dynamic LOD
aliases: Hardware-Assisted Visibility Sorting with Dynamic Level of Detail
definition: An algorithm for dynamic LOD that builds on HAVS, separating boundary and internal faces, sorting internal faces by importance, and dynamically adjusting the number of faces drawn based on frame rate.
summary: HAVS with Dynamic LOD is an algorithm that maintains interactive frame rates by dynamically adjusting the number of internal faces drawn based on render time.
